title: SB 2810 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, allows a student currently enrolled at a public institution of higher education to use a photo identification card issued by the public institution of higher education to verify the student's identity when voting. - Amends TCA Title 2, Chapter 7 and Title 49.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112(c)(3) (Sec. 1, new item in rewritten subsection)
(quote) (3) An identification card issued to a current student by a public institution of higher education containing a photograph of the student;
(section) 2-7-112(c) (Sec. 1, intro of rewritten subsection)
(quote) (c) For purposes of verifying the person's identification on the application for ballot, "evidence of identification" is:
(section) 2-7-112(c)(4) (Sec. 1, listed in rewrite)
(quote) (4) A valid identification card issued pursuant to § 55-50-336;
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 1 (rest of list): reprints a Tennessee driver licence, a state or federal photo ID card, a U.S. passport, a state or federal employee photo ID, a military photo ID and a retired-state-employee ID; the saved text does not show which of these were already in law.
(other) Sec. 2: rules and administration take effect on becoming law; everything else July 1, 2020.
(other) version: 2125832-Draft: Draft only; rewrites all of 2-7-112(c) and adds a current public-college student photo ID as item (3).
(other) note: Title says Title 2, Chapter 7 and Title 49, but the saved text amends only 2-7-112(c). Existing wording of (c) is not saved. Companion HB1590 identical. Last action: referred to Senate State and Local Government 2020-02-10; no roll call saved.
